nodos.resumen: Splitting documents into passages sized for embedding and retrieval — chunk boundaries strongly affect RAG quality.
Dense vectors that place text (or images) in a semantic space where nearby points mean similar things.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation: fetch relevant documents and place them in the prompt so the model answers from grounded, up-to-date context.
Fetching the most relevant passages for a query from a corpus, using keyword, vector, or hybrid search.
